title: 第一章天帝至尊先天祖炁大罗天与神话大罗第二章谋划未来难点
slug: 洪荒走向神话的大天尊
content_zh:
混沌不记年，岁月无痕。
那洪荒之外，无量天上，忽有无数神光炽盛，极尽璀璨，划破虚空，推开混沌而行。
混沌深处，有古老生灵有感，俱被这动静惊扰，微微开阖双眸，欲观其详。
然方触及那六道神光之上，便觉莫大禁忌气息扑面而来，纷纷不敢直视。
——圣威！
圣不可亵渎，不可直视……
那正是六大圣人！
为首者，赫然乃是：
三清：玉清元始天尊、上清灵宝天尊、太清道德天尊；
妖族娲皇、人族圣母，女娲娘娘。
二释：接引道人、准提道人；
洪荒六圣，尽数超脱洪荒，径往混沌而去！
所为何事，已然显而易见。
那混沌之间，有古老神殿在众圣尊崇之中缓缓映照。诸天庆云氤氲，无量金莲涌现，海量道韵缠绕……种种禁忌之下，终得见其中真貌。
古老大气，简朴深邃，唯殿中名号，足以令洪荒摇曳。
紫霄宫！
赫然便是道祖鸿钧无上道场！
嗡……
混沌寂寥。
紫霄宫浮现的刹那，那无数混沌残留生灵，皆是瑟瑟发抖，不敢有半点声响传出。

唯有为首六圣，方有资格论道。
却听得接引道人悲苦开口：“诸位师兄，不知此次老师唤我等前来，所为何事？”
言语之间，颇有试探之意。
圣人一念通晓天下！
然巫妖量劫虽已过去，三界却依旧纷扰不休。巫妖大战，两败俱伤，生灵涂炭，动荡了无尽因果。
如此，方要重定三界格局。天庭早蒙鸿钧扶持而建，可如今帝位空置，令圣人都无法算计。
毫不夸张地说，此位决定的，乃是整个三界后续之走向。
今道祖召唤，十有八九便为此事。
众人心照不宣。
“且静观便是。”
太清圣人虽早已立教，尊崇无为，那眸底却也多出几分光来。
天庭之主！天帝之位！便是圣人亦少有的兴致所在。此中代表之物，实在太多！
闻言，六圣皆默，静静等待。目视紫霄宫，心思各异。
玉清圣人元始天尊想的是，自己的阐教福德上仙：云中子。此乃上古大能红云转世，身负莫大因果福德。
通天教主则是看中自己外门大弟子：赵公明。论跟脚底蕴虽不及云中子，然论为人、修为与战力，分毫不输……自有一争之能。
西方二释则目视弥勒佛：未来佛，福大量大。
至于娲皇女娲与太清圣人，反倒最为平静。
太清圣人因推崇无为随性，严格而言门人唯有玄都一人，这天庭之主实难与之相涉。
女娲娘娘虽有心再扶妖族一把，却也知晓：如今巫妖两败俱伤，人族当立，天帝之位，又如何轮得到妖族？
……
content_en:
Chaos does not remember years, and time has no trace.
Beyond the vast wilderness, in the immeasurable sky, suddenly there were countless divine lights blazing, extremely bright, cutting through the void and pushing away the chaos.
Deep in the chaos, there were ancient creatures who were disturbed by the movement. They opened and closed their eyes slightly, wanting to see the details.
However, as soon as they touched the six divine lights, they felt a huge taboo aura coming towards them, and they didn't dare to look directly.
——Shengwei!
The sacred cannot be blasphemed and cannot be looked directly at...
Those are the six great saints!
The leader is surprisingly:
Sanqing: Yuqing Yuanshi Tianzun, Shangqing Lingbao Tianzun, Taiqing Daode Tianzun;
The demon clan’s Emperor Wa, the human clan’s holy mother, and the empress Nuwa.
Second interpretation: to receive Taoists and to guide Taoists;
The six saints of the prehistoric era all transcended the prehistoric era and headed towards chaos!
It's obvious why.
In the chaos, there is an ancient temple slowly reflecting in the respect of the saints. The heavens are filled with clouds of celebration, immeasurable golden lotuses emerge, and a vast amount of Taoist charms entwine... Under all kinds of taboos, the true appearance can finally be seen.
It is ancient and majestic, simple and profound, but the name in the palace is enough to make the ancient world sway.
Zixiao Palace!
Astonishingly, it is Taozu Hongjun’s Supreme Dojo!
Buzz…
Chaos and loneliness.
The moment Zixiao Palace emerged, the countless remaining creatures of chaos were all trembling, not daring to make any sound.
Only the first six sages are qualified to discuss the Tao.
But I heard the Taoist priest say sadly: "Brothers, I wonder why the teacher called us here this time?"
There is a hint of temptation in the words.
A saint can understand the world with just one thought!
However, although the calamity of Lich has passed, the three realms are still in turmoil. The battle between the lich and the lich has left both sides injured, all lives devastated, and endless cause and effect stirred up.
In this way, the pattern of the Three Realms must be redefined. The Heavenly Court was built with the support of Hongjun, but now the throne is vacant, making it impossible for even the saints to plan.
It is no exaggeration to say that this position determines the subsequent direction of the entire Three Realms.
Today, when the Dao Ancestor calls, it will most likely be for this reason.
Everyone is tacitly understanding.
"Just wait and watch."
Although Saint Taiqing had already established a religion and respected Wuwei, there was a little more light in his eyes.
Lord of Heaven! The position of the Emperor of Heaven! This is the rare interest of a saint. There are so many things represented here!
Hearing this, the six saints were silent and waited quietly. Looking at Zixiao Palace, I have different thoughts.
The Yuqing sage Yuanshi Tianzun thought about his own enlightenment and meritorious deity: Yun Zhongzi. This is the reincarnation of Hong Yun, the ancient great power, and is endowed with great karma and merit.
The leader of Tongtian Cult took a fancy to his outer disciple: Zhao Gongming. Although the foundation of Hefei is not as good as that of Yun Zhongzi, in terms of character, cultivation and combat power, he is not inferior at all... He has the ability to compete.
The second Western interpretation looks at Maitreya Buddha: the future Buddha will bring great blessings.
As for Emperor Wa, Nuwa and Saint Taiqing, they were the calmest.
Because Taiqing Sage respected inaction and followed one's nature, strictly speaking, he only had Xuandu as his disciple, so it was really difficult for him to be involved with the Lord of Heaven.
Although Empress Nuwa wanted to help the demon clan again, she also knew: now both the lich and the lich are harmed, and the human race should be established. How will the demon clan get the position of emperor of heaven?
…
